description.zh: 是否采集控制面日志到SLS。
description.en: Specifies whether to collect control plane logs and send them to SLS.
The retention period of the collected logs, in days.

description.zh: 自定义控制面日志采集目标SLS Project名称。
description.en: The name of the custom SLS project where control plane logs are stored.
The ID of the Service Mesh instance.

title.zh: 修改控制面日志采集配置

example.unifiedCli: aliyun servicemesh update-control-plane-log-config --service-mesh-id c20667db760fe4ee69102201366240000 --enabled false --project aia-asm-deva-sh --log-ttl-in-day 30 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun servicemesh UpdateControlPlaneLogConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Project 'aia-asm-deva-sh' --LogTTLInDay 30 --ServiceMeshId c20667db760fe4ee69102201366240000 --Enabled false
